questions.question: Which of the following is a key objective of the new Constitutional Amendment Bill on delimitation, as highlighted in recent discussions?

To reduce the total number of Lok Sabha seats.
To link Lok Sabha seat distribution exclusively to the 2001 Census.
To extend the population freeze for Lok Sabha seats to 2051.
questions.explanation: The revised Constitutional Amendment Bill on delimitation aims to extend the population freeze for Lok Sabha seats to 2051. It also removes the link between population stability and Lok Sabha share, and narrows Parliament’s discretion on delimitation.
